title: guard-gpu misses script-wrapped dispatches and non-Comfy GPU jobs
description: gpu_command_patterns match the RAW COMMAND LINE, so a graph dispatched from a script (URL inside the .py, command line just `python foo.py`) takes the GPU with no lease and no block. Measured live on MPI-623. Separately, brush_app.exe matches nothing at all - a wgpu trainer MPI-623 is about to ship as a node.
